A second stray triage block runs at top level before the wedge_timer_check definition. At this point set -u is active; escalation_file and win are unset, so script/source loading aborts before the main entry guard or runtime loop.

The legitimate triage call already belongs inside the at-threshold branch of wedge_timer_check, after cheaper deferrals. Both functions are defined before the main loop calls them; relocating the function would not repair the stray startup execution.

The same merge placed an increment before a subsequent reread of the escalation counter, overwriting the increment. Restore counting only after triage chooses escalation so suppression leaves the counter unchanged.

The original Jev addition 703adc1f83 has function-scoped triage and post-triage counting; comparison with the last known good house commit identifies the stray copies and counter regression in house merge 519817f4fe.
